data.name: Galaxian Heavy 8x8 A
data.notes: Galaxian-style MSX2 phase 1. Current ROM runtime supports player, horizontal shooter movement, one player projectile, one enemy projectile, destructible shields, internal score, dive-attack movement, and the 12 authored formation enemy slots rendered as hardware sprites.

data.name: Galaxian Heavy 8x8 B
data.notes: Galaxian-style MSX2 phase 2 with a wider V-shaped formation, more active dive attackers, higher score values, and destructible shields.
